name: Ruggles Eames
role: Early Ohio priest called to preach
dateNote: He was ordained a priest on 25 October 1831 and called to preach by section 75 on 25 January 1832.
importance: Section 75 pairs him with Stephen Burnett to preach. Little is known of his service. He bought property in Caldwell County, Missouri, by 1839 and lived in Iowa Territory by 1840.
connections: Son of Benjamin Eames and Julia Bacon, and husband of Charlotte Rose. Called with Stephen Burnett.
reviewNote: JSP gives birth about 1804 and no death date. Ordination at Orange, Ohio, and later residences checked on JSP.
